name: denubis-hook-branch-bg
description: Colour every tmux pane with a [person][repo][branch][session] title strip and a matching dark field, from the current Git repository and branch.

interface.shortDescription: Color terminal backgrounds by repository and branch
interface.longDescription: Draws a four-block pane title strip in tmux (person, repo, branch, session) with colours assigned through a per-machine registry and black-or-white text chosen by contrast, and sets a near-black shade of the repo colour as the pane field and terminal background (OSC 11).
defaultPrompt: Enable repository and branch background colors for this Codex session.
